messages:
Priya Rao: FYI I opened a tiny PR to tighten up the troubleshooting playbook around 429s vs timeouts. Mainly wording + a quick repro snippet. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1289

Alex Kim: Nice, thanks. Can you add a minimal cURL repro and a short Node snippet for exponential backoff? That’s what most integrators ask for.

Priya Rao: Yep — added both. Also flagged a paragraph about interpreting Retry-After headers — not sure if we should recommend honoring server Retry-After for both 429 and 503. PTAL.

Dmitri Petrov: Quick caveat: for streaming endpoints we should NOT auto-retry on a mid-stream disconnect since partial state matters. Suggest a bold callout and an example of safe vs unsafe retry.

Alex Kim: Agreed. Also can we include a tiny load-loop script that reproduces burst 429s locally (so folks can test their fallback)? I have one that hit our sandbox quickly. Paste below: 

```bash
for i in $(seq 1 40); do
  curl -s -X POST \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate\" \ \
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \ \
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ \
    -d '{\"model\":\"rwd-small\",\"input\":\"ping\"}' &
  sleep 0.2
done
wait
```

Priya Rao: Perfect, I'll graft that into the troubleshooting section under "Reproducing rate limits".

docs-bot: PR 1289 created by priya — CI checks passed: docs-lint, spellcheck.

Lana Ortiz: One more edge case: context-limit failures (we surface as 413/Bad Request in some paths) vs 429. We should add a short decision table: when to trim prompt vs when to backoff/retry. People keep confusing them.

Priya Rao: Good call — I'll add a 3-step checklist: 1) check response code & headers, 2) if 413 -> trim or chunk, 3) if 429 -> retry with jitter/backoff and respect Retry-After if present.

Alex Kim: Can you also add an SDK snippet showing how to do backoff + context trimming hinting? E.g. try N times, if 413 then call a helper to compress/trim prompt and retry once. Keep it tiny.

Priya Rao: Will do. Assigning reviewers @Alex Kim @Dmitri Petrov for quick sanity check.

Alex Kim: :thumbsup: I’ll review tonight and leave inline suggestions.

Dmitri Petrov: Will scan for streaming caveats and the Retry-After wording tomorrow morning.

Priya Rao: Thanks — plan to merge once both approve, then I'll backport a short blurb into the SDK error-ref page.

Lana Ortiz: Thanks for driving this — will circulate a small heads-up in product-help after merge so CS can reference it.

Priya Rao: Awesome. If anyone thinks of additional repro cases (websocket drops, proxy timeouts), drop them here and I’ll try to include a short note.
